clue.text: Try harder to keep the hose shipshape

definitions.meaning: to make a greater effort, an idiom for buckling down
a literal reading: hose are stockings, and hitching them up keeps them neat

explanation.definitionFit: The idiom for making more effort literally describes hitching up one's stockings, which hose are.

clue.text: Glib words about Latin dish

indicators.note: about means the glib-words piece goes round the Latin abbreviation

parts.note: patter is smooth, glib talk

explanation.surface: Someone talks smoothly about a dish with a Latin name.
explanation.definitionFit: A large flat serving plate is a kind of dish.

clue.text: Authorisation to make bequests

definitions.meaning: to bequeath or hand down in a will

explanation.definitionFit: Leave is both permission granted and a verb for bequeathing property in a will.

clue.text: One after another is bustling around

definitions.meaning: kept constantly busy, always on the go

explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means both in succession (three wins in a row) and kept continually busy.

clue.text: Intent on strategy prior to contest's conclusion

indicators.note: in a down answer, on means the first piece sits above the second

parts.note: end means aim or intent, as in to that end
a game is a scheme or plan, as in what's his game?

explanation.surface: A competitor is focused on tactics before a match concludes.
explanation.definitionFit: The final stage of a chess game or other contest is its closing phase.

clue.text: Bill is a tenacious man

definitions.meaning: a bill is a poster or adhesive notice
someone who sticks at things doggedly

explanation.definitionFit: A label or posted notice is a bill, and a persistent person who never gives up is one too.

clue.text: Senior officers get a drink

parts.note: CO is commanding officer, so two of them give CO twice

explanation.surface: High-ranking officers are handed a drink.
explanation.definitionFit: A hot chocolate beverage is a drink.

clue.text: Mixed memories about apprentice wine-waiter

indicators.note: about means the shuffled letters go round the apprentice letter
mixed means the letters of memories are shuffled

parts.note: L for learner, an apprentice driver

explanation.surface: A wine-waiter has muddled recollections of an apprentice.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Mixed' makes SOMMEIER from MEMORIES; 'about' puts it round L.
explanation.definitionFit: A restaurant's wine steward is the person who advises on and serves wine.

clue.text: Moralistic zealot serves a turnip stew

indicators.note: a stew is a mixture cooked together, so the letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: A prim zealot dishes up turnip stew.
explanation.walkthrough: 'stew' rearranges the letters of A TURNIP.
explanation.definitionFit: A person of strict, austere morals is the type named after the 17th-century religious reformers.

clue.text: Expected Austrian leader to get served

indicators.note: the leader of a word is its first letter

parts.note: waited, as at table

explanation.surface: An Austrian politician is expected to be served.
explanation.definitionFit: Something looked forward to and anticipated has been expected.

clue.text: Immigrant awarded revenue by right

parts.note: income is money earned, revenue

explanation.surface: A newcomer to the country is given earnings by legal right.
explanation.definitionFit: A newcomer who arrives to settle in a place is an immigrant.

clue.text: The note needed to leave car by entertainment ground

parts.note: me (or mi) is the third note of the sol-fa scale
to park is to leave a car in a spot

explanation.surface: A notice says a car must not be left near a fairground.
explanation.definitionFit: An amusement venue with rides built around a single idea is an entertainment ground.

clue.text: Resolved later to issue a warning

indicators.note: resolved, broken down and set out anew, signals the letters of later are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone decides later to give a warning.
explanation.definitionFit: To warn someone of danger is to put them on guard, a verb sense.

clue.text: Book written by husband

definitions.meaning: to book is to make a booking in advance
as a verb, to husband is to conserve or keep back resources

explanation.surface: A book has been written by someone's husband.
explanation.walkthrough: 'husband' is a verb here: to husband supplies is to save them. 'written by' just links the two definitions.
explanation.definitionFit: Both senses mean to set something aside: booking a table, and holding back supplies for later.

clue.text: Hearing nothing disheartened each fellow

annotationWithheld.why: Clue as held: 'Hearing nothing disheartened each fellow (5,4)'. With EA (each) and F (fellow) the wordplay needs STONED, and 'disheartened' does not give it; the clue looks garbled.

clue.text: Slav has to head off east German

indicators.note: heading off means the first letter is removed

parts.note: a Prussian came from the old state in eastern Germany

explanation.surface: A Slav must head off an East German.
explanation.definitionFit: A person from Russia is a member of the Slavic peoples.

clue.text: The lady will fit into a leisure ensemble

parts.note: she will shortens to she'll
to suit is to fit or become someone

explanation.surface: A woman will fit into a tracksuit outfit.
explanation.definitionFit: A shiny nylon tracksuit, a casual outfit popular in the 1980s, is a leisure ensemble.

clue.text: Rowling's hero captured many a conspirator

indicators.note: captured means the hero's name holds the next piece inside it

parts.note: Harry Potter is the boy wizard in J. K. Rowling's books
L is the Roman numeral fifty, a crossword stand-in for many

explanation.surface: A boy wizard caught lots of plotters.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who schemes secretly is a conspirator.

clue.text: Applauded coppers given promotion

parts.note: P for pence, copper coins in British money
raised, lifted to a higher rank

explanation.surface: Police officers were cheered when they got promoted.
explanation.definitionFit: Speaking highly of someone means they were praised, which is what applause expresses.

clue.text: One church midst others is least impoverished

indicators.note: midst means the pieces go into the middle of others

parts.note: the rest means the others
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: One church among many is the least poor.
explanation.definitionFit: Having the most money is the opposite of being least impoverished.

clue.text: Discredited for having left dirty marks

explanation.definitionFit: To smear is both to slander someone's name and to smudge a surface with dirt.

clue.text: Pictures two Americans mounted depict eastern island

indicators.note: in a down answer, mounted means the whole string is read upwards

parts.note: art means pictures and paintings
AM for American and US for United States, two ways of saying American
AM for American and US for United States, two ways of saying American

explanation.surface: Pictures by two Americans, framed and hung, show an island in the East.
explanation.definitionFit: The large Indonesian island lies in the East Indies.

clue.text: Lessening of tension inside ten territories

annotationWithheld.why: Clue as held: 'Lessening of tension inside ten territories (7)'. TEN sits inside DE...TE, but no word gives those letters; 'territories' cannot supply DE and TE, so the clue looks garbled.
annotationWithheld.clue: Lessening of tension inside ten territories

clue.text: Battleground for sappers in an African capital

indicators.note: in means the sappers go inside the word an

parts.note: RE, the Royal Engineers, whose soldiers are called sappers

indicators.note: the capital of a word is its first letter

explanation.surface: Sappers are posted to a capital city in Africa, a battleground.
explanation.definitionFit: An arena is a place of conflict or contest, as in the political arena.

clue.text: Stranger has a right to retain property

parts.note: a lien is a legal right to hold property until a debt is paid

explanation.surface: A stranger claims a legal right to keep someone's property.
explanation.definitionFit: A foreigner or outsider is a stranger.

clue.text: Obliging committee I found in factory

indicators.note: found in means the letter I is placed inside factory

parts.note: a plant is a factory

explanation.surface: An accommodating committee is discovered in a works.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone obliging is willing to go along with requests, accommodating.

clue.text: Athenian put a sober man in charge

parts.note: TT, a teetotaller who drinks no alcohol

explanation.surface: An Athenian put a teetotaller in command.
explanation.definitionFit: Attic describes things of Attica, the region around Athens, so it means Athenian.

clue.text: Getting disinfected is fruitless

definitions.meaning: free from germs, clean in a medical sense

explanation.definitionFit: The word covers both germ-free cleanliness and inability to bear offspring or fruit.

clue.text: Gibe about county town

parts.note: a taunt is a jeer or gibe
on means about or concerning

explanation.surface: Someone jeers at a provincial town.
explanation.walkthrough: A county town is the administrative centre of an English county; this one is Somerset's.
explanation.definitionFit: It is the administrative centre of Somerset, an English county, so a county town.

clue.text: The precise thing

parts.note: read as grammar: the word 'The' is the specific article in English, and that article is precise, a definite thing

explanation.definitionFit: In grammar 'the' is the article that picks out a specific item, as opposed to 'a'.
